name: Power Matrix
description: Artifact the crew seeks in Saprazzo.

description_citations.text: "Saprazzo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath kills the chief artificer for failing to join the Power Matrix to the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: For her failure, Volrath kills her too, but at least now her assistant, the new chief, knows what they need.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Saprazzans relinquish the Power Matrix to the Weatherlight crew upon learning it is part of the Legacy.
timeline.quote: relinquished it to the Weatherlight crew when they learned it was part of the Legacy

citation.text: "Merfolk", section "Saprazzan Merfolk". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With hostages held, the Mercadians force Hanna, Sisay and Orim to retrieve the Power Matrix from Saprazzo, then steal it and murder its guardians.
timeline.quote: the Mercadians betrayed them again, stealing the artifact and murdering its guardians while attempting to frame Orim

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The upgraded Weatherlight leaves Mercadia and Gerrard leads the crew back to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Gerrard, having embraced his role as a leader and savior, led his crew back to Dominaria

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Gerrard, Tahngarth and Karn are arrested in Mercadia, Sisay, Hanna and Orim strike a deal with the Chief Magistrate to travel to Saprazzo for the Power Matrix.
timeline.quote: After the arrest of Gerrard , Tahngarth , and Karn in Mercadia
